instruction: Activate Ubuntu's Night Light feature to reduce blue light emission in the evening.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling Night Light feature to reduce blue light. The config disables it first (sets to false), and the evaluator checks that the agent enabled it (changed to true). Uses GNOME color settings daemon schema.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies Night Light activation by checking GNOME gsettings value
Getter uses correct command: 'gsettings get org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.color night-light-enabled'
Metric performs correct exact match comparison for 'true\n' output
Expected value 'true\n' correctly includes newline character that gsettings outputs
Config properly sets initial state to false, requiring agent to enable Night Light
Complete coverage: instruction only requires enabling Night Light, which is fully verified
No postconfig needed: gsettings persists state independently of UI
